inputs.text: The turmoil involving the US, Israel and Iran shows how events abroad can hit Indian families when we rely so heavily on imported crude. Stable petrol and diesel prices and the government’s excise-duty cuts offer welcome protection for households, but this cushion costs revenue and may add to inflation. Temporary relief cannot replace national resilience. India must treat energy security as a matter of sovereignty and steadily reduce its exposure to shocks beyond our control.
